texto_aprovado: The sharks don't get a number of their own: the records count them with all the other sea animals that have no venom. The crocodiles killed 13 people in that decade. The saltwater crocodile isn't only Australia's: it lives from Sri Lanka to northern Australia. After decades of commercial hunting, the Northern Territory protected it in 1971, and it came back.
